notes: TOLLGATE (TOLL) is a technical rehearsal of a fee-and-cap Uniswap v4 hook ahead of a later production launch by the same requester. It is not a consumer product and claims nothing beyond what src/TollgateHook.sol and src/TollToken.sol do. CREATOR FEE DISCLOSURE: TollgateHook charges 2% in native ETH on every buy (ETH -> TOLL) and every sell (TOLL -> ETH) of any pool on this hook whose currency0 is native ETH. 100% of those fees are owed to the fixed creator wallet 0x70c6C4fcaAb11151FCEDb32eaaC3431547193A0a until exactly 1 ETH has accrued (CREATOR_CAP). The permissionless payCreator() pays what is owed and reverts NothingDue otherwise; the creator can never receive more than 1 ETH in total from this contract. After the cap every further fee is burnable: the permissionless burnEth() sends the whole burnable amount to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD (BURN_SINK), at most once every 5 blocks counted from deployment (TooSoon) and only when at least 0.01 ETH is burnable (NothingToBurn). CapReached(totalFees, blockNumber) is emitted exactly once, in the swap that crosses the cap. IMMUTABILITY: recipient, cap, rates, sink, minimum burn and cooldown are compile-time constants. No owner, admin, pause, upgrade, proxy, fee setter, recipient setter or sweep. The hook's only constructor argument is the PoolManager address above (canonical Uniswap v4 PoolManager on Ethereum mainnet); everything else is a literal in the source. Retargeting to another chain means substituting that chain's canonical PoolManager and re-mining the CREATE2 salt, not recompiling. PERMISSIONS: exactly beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta (address mask 0x00CC), validated by the constructor. No beforeInitialize or other initialize gate, no liquidity or donate callbacks: anyone can open pools and LPs can always exit. MECHANICS: exact-in buys and exact-out sells pay the fee from beforeSwap as a positive specified BeforeSwapDelta; exact-out buys and exact-in sells pay 2% of the ETH the pool moved from afterSwap as a positive unspecified delta. The fee is collected inside the swap as ERC-6909 claims on id 0 via poolManager.mint(hook, 0, fee); no ETH is pushed and no contract other than the PoolManager is called from a swap callback, so the first buy into a pool holding no ETH works. A partial fill (raw pool delta on the specified side != amountSpecified + fee) reverts with PartialFill. Pools whose currency0 is not native ETH pay nothing and get zero deltas. Ledger: creatorEntitlement = min(1 ETH, totalFees); burnable = totalFees - creatorEntitlement - burned; invariant PoolManager.balanceOf(hook, 0) >= totalFees - creatorPaid - burned. Claims third parties transfer to the hook are not counted and are stuck. Reentrancy lock on transient slot 1; no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT in any compiled runtime. TOKEN: TollToken is a self-contained ERC-20 with a zero-argument constructor that mints the entire fixed supply to msg.sender (the LaunchFactory); 18 decimals; burn and burnFrom only reduce supply; no owner, mint, pause or proxy. POOL: currency0 native ETH (pairedCurrency zero address), currency1 TOLL, static LP fee 3000 (0.30%, to LPs, separate from the hook fee), tick spacing 60, initialPrice is sqrtPriceX96 for 1 ETH = 1,000,000 TOLL. test/LaunchRehearsal.t.sol opens that pool, seeds one-sided token liquidity below the opening price, buys first into the ETH-less pool and sells after a buy. Supply, allocations, chain and policy are not manifest fields; they come from the launch policy. REVIEW POINTS: verify the creator cap (1 ETH), the recipient constant, the sink constant and that nothing can change them. Tests passing is not an audit; an independent adversarial review and a fork rehearsal against the live PoolManager are required before any production launch. Build settings and vendored v4-core 1.0.2: foundry.toml, docs/dependencies.md; disclosure: README.md, docs/DISCLOSURE.md.
